description.zh: 31 个克苏鲁神话主题图标：旧日支配者、异族、诡异地点与仪式道具。全部为原创的扁平几何 / 符号化诠释，取材于公有领域时代的神话概念，不含任何游戏或影视角色形象，也没有血腥元素（PG 级）。深海青、暗紫、金色的配色贯穿整套，每个图标自带 ck- 前缀的 CSS 动画（弹跳 / 漂浮 / 旋转 / 脉冲 / 摇摆），互相内联也不会冲突。
description.en: 31 Cthulhu Mythos icons covering Great Old Ones, alien races, eerie places and ritual artifacts. Every design is an original flat geometric / symbolic interpretation of public-domain-era mythos concepts: no game or film character likenesses and no gore (PG). A deep-sea teal, dark purple and gold palette runs through the set, and each icon carries its own ck- prefixed CSS animation (pop / float / spin / pulse / sway) so they can be inlined side by side without clashing.

description.zh: 青绿色圆头、金色双眼、两侧蝠翼与四条垂落触须，在深海中缓缓浮沉。整套主题的封面图标。
description.en: Teal round head with golden eyes, bat-like wings and four dangling tentacles, slowly drifting as if underwater. The cover icon of the set.

description.zh: 紫色核心球体周围环绕六颗粉色眼球，整体呼吸般脉动，象征“门之钥”与万物同在的无数视线。
description.en: A purple core orb ringed by six pink eyeballs, pulsing like breath: the countless gazes of the Key and the Gate.

description.zh: 黑色斗篷三角身形、紫色兜帽下一片虚无面孔，胸前一枚金色菱形，静静漂浮。“伏行之混沌”的剪影。
description.en: A black cloaked silhouette under a purple hood with a faceless void and a golden diamond at the chest, floating silently. The Crawling Chaos in outline.

description.zh: 三道交错的粉色轨道环绕一颗珊瑚色混沌星核与金色中心，持续旋转，如同宇宙中心盲目痴愚的漩涡。
description.en: Three crossing pink orbits around a coral chaos star with a golden core, spinning endlessly like the blind idiot vortex at the center of the cosmos.

description.zh: 墨黑色团簇云体点缀荧绿斑点，下方伸出蹄状触足，周期性鼓胀。“孕育千子的黑山羊”的抽象化形象。
description.en: An ink-black cluster of cloud-like masses speckled with slime-green dots and hoof-like legs below, swelling rhythmically. An abstract Black Goat of the Woods with a Thousand Young.

description.zh: 青绿色巨鱼侧影，头顶金色冠冕、鳃纹清晰，随水流上下浮动。深潜者崇拜的海神。
description.en: A teal giant fish in profile with a golden crown and clear gill lines, bobbing with the current. The sea god worshipped by the Deep Ones.

description.zh: 三条深青长颈从浪花中探出，各顶着一颗金眼蛇首，节奏性弹跳。大衮的伴侣、海中之母。
description.en: Three long dark-teal necks rising from the waves, each with a gold-eyed serpent head, popping in rhythm. Mother Hydra, consort of Dagon.

description.zh: 金色圆盘上三道墨色弯钩围绕中心旋转，以抽象符号代表“不可言说者”与黄衣之王。
description.en: Three ink hooks curling around a center on a golden disc, rotating. An abstract sign standing in for the Unspeakable One and the King in Yellow.

description.zh: 半透明紫色光晕、粉色虚线环与漆黑核心，四周散落微弱星点，缓慢旋转。象征吞噬一切的宇宙虚无。
description.en: A translucent purple halo, a dashed pink ring and a pitch-black core with faint stars scattered around, slowly turning. The all-devouring cosmic void.

description.zh: 青绿色鱼人脸、鼓起的金色大眼、两侧鳍耳与腮纹，轻轻漂浮。印斯茅斯血脉的终点。
description.en: A teal fish-folk face with bulging golden eyes, fin ears and gill marks, gently floating. Where the Innsmouth bloodline ends up.

description.zh: 灰色尖耳犬面、荧绿眼睛与锯齿骨白牙，弹跳出场。游荡于墓地与地下隧道的种族。
description.en: A grey canine face with pointed ears, glowing green eyes and jagged bone-white teeth, popping into view. A race that haunts graveyards and underground tunnels.

description.zh: 粉色半透明膜翼、珊瑚色分节躯干与触角头部，悬停漂浮。来自犹格斯星的真菌甲壳生物。
description.en: Translucent pink membrane wings, a segmented coral body and an antennaed head, hovering in place. The fungoid crustaceans from Yuggoth.

description.zh: 荧绿色流动原生质团块上睁着六只大小不一的眼睛，呼吸般鼓胀收缩。古老者的造物与反叛者。
description.en: A slime-green mass of flowing protoplasm with six mismatched eyes, swelling and shrinking like breath. Servitor and rebel of the Elder Things.

description.zh: 墨黑蝠翼、头生弯角、无面的深蓝细长身躯与卷曲尾巴，在夜空中悄然滑翔。
description.en: Ink-black bat wings, curved horns, a faceless slender navy body and a curling tail, gliding silently through the night sky.

description.zh: 三块倾斜的青色巨石破浪而出，覆着荧绿苔痕，角度违背常理的非欧几何建筑。
description.en: Three tilted teal monoliths breaking the waves, streaked with green slime: non-Euclidean architecture at impossible angles.

description.zh: 木栈桥、灰色小屋与挂着金色提灯的灯柱，下方是深青色海浪，随潮水起伏。
description.en: A wooden pier, a grey shack and a lamppost with a golden lantern above dark-teal waves, rising and falling with the tide.

description.zh: 月光下的深蓝老宅，紫色尖顶、烟囱、亮着金光的窗户与拱形黑门。新英格兰怪谈的标准场景。
description.en: A navy old house under the moon with a purple gable, chimney, gold-lit windows and an arched black door. The classic New England weird-tale setting.

description.zh: 星空下的深青巨峰，骨白雪顶之上矗立着紫色高塔与一扇金窗，柔和脉动。梦境中未知的卡达斯。
description.en: A dark-teal peak under the stars with a bone-white snowcap crowned by a purple tower and one golden window, softly pulsing. Unknown Kadath of the Dreamlands.

description.zh: 深蓝圆角方框内的青色穹顶与尖塔建筑群，水泡缓缓上升，整体随水波漂浮。可作为 App 图标或徽章。
description.en: Teal domes and spires inside a deep-blue rounded tile with bubbles drifting upward, floating with the water. Works as an app icon or badge.

description.zh: 棕色皮革封面、骨白书页边缘，封面中央是金色圆环与凝视之眼，四角金钉。禁忌知识的象征。
description.en: A brown leather tome with bone-white page edges, a golden ring and staring eye on the cover and gold studs at the corners. The emblem of forbidden knowledge.

description.zh: 金色柄首与护手、珊瑚色宝石、波浪形灰色刃身，以顶部为支点左右摇摆。
description.en: A gold pommel and crossguard, a coral gem and a wavy grey blade, swinging like a pendulum from the top.

description.zh: 青色描边五角星中央一只金色眼睛与珊瑚色火焰，柔和脉动。抵御旧日支配者的守护符号。
description.en: A teal outlined pentagram with a golden eye and a coral flame at its center, softly pulsing. The warding sign against the Great Old Ones.

description.zh: 金色虚线链条挂着银灰圆形吊坠，上刻青色五角星与珊瑚色宝石，左右轻摆。
description.en: A silver-grey round pendant on a dotted gold chain, engraved with a teal star and a coral gem, gently swaying.

description.zh: 紫色六边形护符，金色内框与向外展开的螺旋纹，持续旋转。秘密教团的身份信物。
description.en: A purple hexagonal amulet with a golden inner frame and an outward spiral, spinning continuously. The token of a secret cult.

description.zh: 棕色握柄与金色尾珠，鞭身是一条带骨白吸盘的青色卷曲触手，摇摆挥动。
description.en: A brown grip with a gold end-cap and a curling teal tentacle lash dotted with bone-white suckers, swaying as it swings.

description.zh: 深蓝提灯框里封着紫色夜空与金色星辰，灯光明灭脉动。照亮梦境之路的道具。
description.en: A navy lantern frame holding a purple night sky and golden stars, its light flickering in a pulse. A lamp for the paths of the Dreamlands.

description.zh: 骨白羊皮纸配棕色卷轴杆，纸上写着深青色的未知符文，轻轻漂浮。
description.en: Bone-white parchment between brown rollers, inscribed with dark-teal unknown glyphs, gently floating.

description.zh: 骨白面具、墨黑斜眼孔、额心珊瑚色宝石，下颌垂着三道青色触须纹，弹跳出现。
description.en: A bone-white mask with slanted ink eye holes, a coral gem on the brow and three teal tentacle marks below the chin, popping into view.

description.zh: 棕色软木塞的锥形烧瓶，盛着冒泡的荧绿药液，缓缓漂浮。炼金或复活药剂。
description.en: A cork-stoppered conical flask of bubbling slime-green liquid, slowly floating. An alchemical draught or reanimation serum.

description.zh: 金色外环、深蓝表盘与四点星位，珊瑚与青色交叉指针持续旋转，指向星辰正确的方位。
description.en: A gold rim, a deep-blue dial with four star points and crossed coral and teal needles that keep spinning, pointing to when the stars are right.

description.zh: 金色圆环钥匙头中嵌着紫色眼睛，长柄末端是阶梯形钥齿，悬空漂浮。开启异界之门的钥匙。
description.en: A golden ring-headed key with a purple eye inset and stepped teeth at the end of a long shaft, hovering in the air. The key that opens the gates between worlds.
